value.syntax: # [doc = " Filesystem identity of a redirection target."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " This is the **sole** package-local exception to lexical output-role"] # [doc = " comparison `(´guide:execwrap:execwrap´)`, which requires the"] # [doc = " exception to state four things:"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " **The exact hazard.** Two redirection routes resolving to one file"] # [doc = " are opened independently, each with truncation, and then written"] # [doc = " concurrently by the wrapper as the child produces output. The"] # [doc = " result is one log with interleaved and partially overwritten"] # [doc = " bytes, and no I/O call fails at any point. The damage is done to"] # [doc = " the operation's own output, not to repository state."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " **The additional check.** Each target is resolved to a filesystem"] # [doc = " identity before anything is opened: device and inode for an"] # [doc = " existing file (so symlinks and hard links collapse), and resolved"] # [doc = " parent directory plus file name for one that does not exist yet."] # [doc = " A dangling symlink resolves to its ultimate target, because"] # [doc = " creating the file would follow the link."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " **Why lexical uniqueness is insufficient here.** Lexical"] # [doc = " comparison catches `a.log` against `./a.log`, but not two names"] # [doc = " hard-linked to one file, nor two paths beneath a symlinked"] # [doc = " directory, nor a dangling link and the name it points at. Those"] # [doc = " all produce the interleaving above, and unlike an ordinary output"] # [doc = " role — which the caller controls end to end — these paths are"] # [doc = " routinely assembled by build glue where such aliases arise by"] # [doc = " accident."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " **The remaining host race.** None of this closes a"] # [doc = " time-of-check/time-of-use window: the host may replace or remount"] # [doc = " any of these paths between the check and the open. This is a"] # [doc = " preflight guard against configuration mistakes and nothing more."] # [doc = " It is a package-local correctness measure, never a"] # [doc = " repository-wide filesystem security claim."] # [derive (Debug , PartialEq , Eq)] enum FileIdentity { # [doc = " The target exists: device and inode numbers (symlinks"] # [doc = " followed, hard links share the pair)."] Existing (u64 , u64) , # [doc = " The target does not exist yet: resolved parent directory plus"] # [doc = " final file name."] Pending (PathBuf , OsString) , }
